# anotifier

> anotifier is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), zero-dependency CLI that sends
> notifications when AI coding agents finish a task or need input. It wires into
> each agent's native hook system — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI,
> and any of them inside VS Code — and delivers desktop toasts (Windows/macOS/
> Linux/WSL), phone push via ntfy (Android/iOS, no account), webhooks (Slack,
> Discord, Telegram, any HTTP endpoint), and a terminal bell. Setup is one
> command: `npx anotifier@latest setup`. Config lives at ~/.anotifier/config.json.
> Everything runs locally; nothing is sent anywhere except the channels you
> configure, and phone push is generic text by default. (Version 1.3.0 and later
> can also send opt-in anonymous usage stats; they are off unless you say yes.)

## Full documentation

- [Complete docs, plain text](https://anotifier.io/llms-full.txt): the entire reference plus every guide and the comparison, as markdown — read this first
- [Docs (HTML)](https://anotifier.io/docs/): install, setup wizard, all 7 CLI commands, every config key with defaults, events, channels, privacy, troubleshooting, FAQ

## Guides (how to get notified when an agent finishes)

- [Claude Code](https://anotifier.io/guides/claude-code-notifications/): which event fires when (Stop = finished, Notification = permission_prompt / idle_prompt after about 60 s), built-in terminal bell or desktop notification (Ghostty, Kitty, iTerm2), a hook you write for macOS, Linux and Windows, ntfy phone push, Claude Code's own Remote Control push, anotifier (Stop and Notification hooks, rich toast text, idle-reminder priority, snooze and quiet hours), fixes when nothing arrives
- [Codex CLI](https://anotifier.io/guides/codex-cli-notifications/): built-in [tui] notifications, notify command, Stop/PermissionRequest hooks, approval alerts, Windows (Windows Terminal bell, commandWindows toast hook), turning notifications off
- [Cursor](https://anotifier.io/guides/cursor-agent-notifications/): Cursor's built-in completion sound and OS notification, the stop hook in ~/.cursor/hooks.json (format, macOS/Linux/Windows examples), phone push and Slack, Windows/WSL, troubleshooting, turning it off; anotifier alerts are titled "my-app · Cursor" and say "my-app: Task complete" (1.8.0 and later; just "Cursor" and "Task complete" before)
- [Gemini CLI](https://anotifier.io/guides/gemini-cli-notifications/): built-in general.enableNotifications terminal alert, AfterAgent (run finished) and Notification (tool waiting for approval) hooks in ~/.gemini/settings.json with the exact JSON shape, stdin fields and per-OS toast and sound commands, ntfy phone push, hooks-not-firing fixes; Antigravity CLI uses a different hook format; anotifier 1.4.0+ wires it separately with a Stop hook in ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json (Task complete only, no needs-input alert, not yet tested against a live Antigravity CLI)
- [Antigravity CLI](https://anotifier.io/guides/antigravity-cli-notifications/): built-in notifications setting in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json (desktop notification and bell, also for questions and permission prompts), Stop hook in ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json (it must print a {"decision":"stop"} answer), toast and sound per OS, ntfy push, Gemini CLI differences, and anotifier 1.4.0+ (Task complete only, no needs-input alert, not yet tested against a live Antigravity CLI)
- [Claude Code permission and waiting-for-input notifications](https://anotifier.io/guides/claude-code-permission-notifications/): permission_prompt and idle_prompt matchers, every notification type, timing, PermissionRequest, phone push
- [Claude Code notification sound](https://anotifier.io/guides/claude-code-notification-sound/): terminal_bell setting, Stop hook with afplay / paplay / pw-play / aplay / PowerShell, a sound per hook event (Stop, PermissionRequest, Notification), Windows and WSL, async hooks, no-sound troubleshooting (Apple Terminal, VS Code), turning the sound off
- [Claude Code usage limit warning](https://anotifier.io/guides/claude-code-usage-limit-notifications/): get notified before the 5-hour or weekly usage limit; a statusline script reading rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage and resets_at, or anotifier 1.5.0+ (alerts at 70/85/95%, Claude.ai Pro and Max only)
- [Claude Code auto-compact](https://anotifier.io/guides/claude-code-auto-compact-warning/): when auto-compact runs, turn it off with autoCompactEnabled or DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT, /compact vs /clear, what survives compaction, and a warning before it happens (statusline script, or anotifier 1.6.0+ at 85%)
- [Claude Code hooks security](https://anotifier.io/guides/claude-code-hooks-security/): what a hook can run (any shell command with your user permissions), where hooks come from, the cloned-repo and plugin risks, /hooks, disableAllHooks, allowManagedHooksOnly, Codex/Gemini CLI/Cursor review steps, and what anotifier's own hooks do and send
- [ccnotify: which one is which](https://anotifier.io/guides/ccnotify/): several unrelated Claude Code notifiers share the name ccnotify (dazuiba/CCNotify, the npm and PyPI packages, Rust, Go and menu-bar apps); what each does, how to tell which is installed, a comparison with anotifier, and how to switch or run both
- [Codex CLI notification sound](https://anotifier.io/guides/codex-notification-sound/): make Codex ding when it needs approval or a response (Plan mode prompt, question): [tui] notifications, notification_method = "bel", notification_condition = "always", PermissionRequest sound hook
- [All guides](https://anotifier.io/guides/)

## Platform and troubleshooting guides

- [Windows and WSL](https://anotifier.io/guides/windows-wsl-notifications/): Claude Code and Codex toasts on native Windows (PowerShell 7, BurntToast, what setup installs, click-to-focus) and in WSL (powershell.exe interop, no wsl-notify-send needed), Do not disturb / Focus Assist, fixes by symptom (errors.log causes, execution policy, interop disabled in wsl.conf), the "wsl.exe exit code -1" VS Code error, sending a test toast
- [wsl-notify-send](https://anotifier.io/guides/wsl-notify-send/): Windows toasts from WSL with wsl-notify-send.exe or plain powershell.exe, wired to Claude Code and Codex
- [macOS and Linux](https://anotifier.io/guides/macos-linux-notifications/): osascript and Notification Center permissions, notify-send
- [Agent hooks explained](https://anotifier.io/guides/agent-hooks-explained/): which hook each agent fires, where it is configured, what setup writes
- [Notifications not working](https://anotifier.io/guides/notifications-not-working/): status, test and doctor, common causes and fixes
- [Claude Code ntfy: phone push](https://anotifier.io/guides/ntfy-phone-notifications/): get Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI to push to your phone through ntfy: app and topic setup with anotifier, a by-hand Stop/Notification hook that curls ntfy, priority and tags, private topics and why anotifier (as of 1.8.0) sends no access token to ntfy, self-hosted servers and fallbackServer, iOS upstream-base-url, a curl test, fixes by symptom
